sentence: This project studies how tumors with mutations become resistant to targeted drugs and tests drugs that target cells to enhance the immune response.
This project studies when bacteria make a type of pilus, what controls the timing, and how viruses use the structure.
This project examines whether state economic support policies prevent child abuse and neglect, and how families and service providers see local policy implementation.
This project tries to find genetic drivers of cognitive function in a large cohort of Mexican teachers using whole genome sequences.
This project studies nerve cells in the cornea to understand how they play a role in eye pain and dry eye disease.
This project studies how grafts of human neural stem cells improve motor recovery after spinal cord injury in a large animal model.
This project tests whether metabolites in the plasma of pregnant women can predict the risk of childhood obesity.
This project builds mass spectrometry reference databases for common environmental chemicals and their metabolites to help identify exposome molecules.
This project tries to find where neurosteroids and cholesterol bind to integral membrane proteins and how they affect protein function.
This project designs de novo proteins that bind small molecules and catalyze reactions, for fluorescence imaging and enzyme catalysis.
This project measures how phospholipids move between organelles and tries to find the network that preserves organelle phospholipid composition.
This project studies a sex-specific long noncoding RNA in mouse models to learn how it helps maintain lipid homeostasis.
This project studies how cells release chemical signals by exocytosis, including in human neurons.
This project develops a tool using smartphones and smart watches to promote abstinence from alcohol among individuals with atrial fibrillation.
This project uses mass spectrometry to define how proteins interact and how modifications to them control the DNA damage response and DNA repair.
This project uses electronic health record data to better address oral health disparities among underserved adults who seek dental treatment in emergency departments.
This project tries to find out how mutations in a kinase cause Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis, using neurons, Drosophila models and postmortem patient tissue.
This project tests whether targeted gold nanoparticles can improve laser interstitial thermal therapy for glioblastoma.
This project uses computer vision to analyze images of self-injury tissue damage in emergency departments to help identify youth and young adults at suicide risk.
This project tries to prevent resistance to inhibitors in mutant pancreatic cancer by targeting both tumor cells and the tumor microenvironment.
